notes.title: Update 2.3
notes.notes:
Added a bunch of new achievements and fixed a few bugs.
Hope you enjoy! :)

notes.title: Tiny Car Mess - Update 2.0
notes.notes:
The first major update is here! Stuff added in 2.0:
- A new map (Arena)
- Old map updated
- Airdrops and powerups added
- Various quality of life changes
- 50% less bugs (I hope)

A big thanks to anyone who plays the game!

notes.title: A small update (1.3), Tiny Car Mess.
notes.notes:
Various performance and UI fixes. Hoping I will get to optimize the game even further more in the future. Car colors more vibrant now. More cars and customization coming soon! 

Many thanks to a few who tried the game. Happy New Year!

notes.title: Tiny Car Mess just released!
notes.notes:

Plus, get ready for upcoming releases of new cosmetics, additional cars, and exciting new game modes and minigames! Don't miss out – try it now!
